name: ANT Custom Translations
description: Adds custom translation overrides for Auto Node Translate by importing translation pairs from a spreadsheet.
project_description:
This is a sub-module of Auto Node Translate . 
 
 
 
 This module provides the ability to add custom translations from a spreadsheet.

 Custom Translations 

 Sometimes you have terms or expressions that need a specific translation for a language this module allows that by specifying on the spreadsheet.

 
 Untranslatable expressions 

 Sometimes you don't want an expression or word to be translatable, for example a company name, this is also configurable on the spreadsheet

 Spreadsheet 

 The spreadsheet can be in xls,xlsx or osd format.

For untranslatable expressions create a sheet with the name "untrans" and insert the expressions in the first column.

For custom translations create a sheet named with the language id you want to specify the translation and add the pairs origin/destination to the first and second column.

For an example check the attached file translation_example.ods.

 Normal module installation procedure.
